findings.impact: No current-capacity problem at the stated loads. Each listed via is a single point of failure: an open or later-cracked via at (24.3,66.0) removes the battery feed to VLOGIC, so the primary computer loses power in flight and recovery falls to the isolated Blue Jay; (29.5,82.05) silently removes the 470 uF hold-up (ride-through falls to roughly 0.03-0.2 ms on C6/C7 alone, against the recorded 0.49-0.57 ms; Calculation); (42.0,61.8), (25.9,8.6), (25.65,14.9) and (29.75,12.6) drop the camera or both GPS and radio (EN floating for the last-but-one); (27.0,49.25) / (16.0,50.2) remove VDDA / VREF+ or the IMU and barometer supply. A pack-only power-up on first articles screens a manufacturing open of the U11 via; nothing screens the C84 via unless hold-up or VLOGIC capacitance is measured; latent barrel cracks are not screened. Bounded residual (Minor): no demonstrated failure.
findings.concrete_fix: At the next CAD change give each listed transition a second same-net via or a second outer-layer path, prioritising U11.2 / C97.1 (RAW_PROTECTED) and C84.1 (VLOGIC); at U11 this needs a local re-route (no legal octilinear spot within about 1 mm was found), so it is a respin item, not a drop-in. Until then: (a) add to ORDERING section 8.3 first-article steps a pack-only power-up (USB disconnected) and a C84-connected check (VLOGIC capacitance at TP83, or measured hold-up after a pack break), and (b) list these single-via transitions with their measured currents in R10_VALIDATION deviation section 4 "Continuous power necks" next to the U9 entries; (c) extend the R18-GATE-03 gate pin to U11.2, U402.1, U401 and C84.1.

Bisection on the unfractured fill deflated by w/2 (pcbnew Deflate, round corners, 1 um error): island A to main splits at w = 0.5495 mm, at about (26.92,61.98) beside the In2 USB_LIMITED corner; the finger splits internally at w = 0.4745 mm at (23.46,67.83), between the GND via (22.825,67.825) clearance and the finger edge (the passage west of that via is about 0.3 mm, so the total cross-section there is about 0.75 mm). rejected_or_closed_candidates.candidate: U9 TPS259470L latch-off could disable the board after a recharge transient
rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: Closed. TPS259470x is the active-current-limit variant (SLVSFC9C p4 Device Comparison); overcurrent is limited, not latched (Table 7-3 p38: persistent overcurrent -> current limit, not latched); only thermal shutdown latches the L variant (Table 7-2 p37). Fast-trip at 2 x ILIM retries after 30 us in current limit (section 7.3.5.4, p34). Reverse-current-blocking recovery tSWRCB 50 us (p11).

Closed. ILIM 750 ohm (R84 0.1 %) -> 3.960/4.452/4.840 A (p9 table; recommended RILM 549-6650 ohm p8). UVLO from R80+R165 940 k / R81 300 k: 1.183/1.20/1.223 V rising -> 4.96 V, 1.09 V falling -> 4.51 V (p9). OVLO 2 M / 280 k: 1.20 V -> 9.77 V; OVLO pin 1.03 V at 8.4 V within the 0.5-1.5 V recommended range (p8). dVdt C81 4.7 nF C0G 50 V >= VIN + 5 V rating rule (p8); 2000/4700 = 0.43 V/ms (eq. 4 p30). EN and OVLO pull-ups >= 350 kohm for reverse polarity (p7 note 2). ITIMER open = fastest (pin table p6). IMAX 5.5 A.
